title: Tech Saturn Vol. 2/1996: Maitsuki 8-nichi wa Tessa no Hi: Ataru to Sugo Iyo
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ ＳＡＴＵＲＮ Ｖｏｌ．２／１９９６ 毎月８日はテッサの日 アタるとスゴいよ
overview: Tech Saturn Vol. 2/1996 is the Sega Saturn CD-ROM that came packed in a sleeve inside that issue of Tech Saturn, ASCII's Saturn magazine. Each issue's disc mixed trial versions of Saturn games with original content made by the magazine's own staff.
